title: FileNode/set: null mediaType must reset to default (filenode-17+)
description: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-17 changed null mediaType from invalidProperties to a reset: -19 §3.1.2 'If not provided on creation, or if set to null, the server sets it to "application/octet-stream".' Changelog -17: 'Setting mediaType to null now resets it to "application/octet-stream" rather than being an error.' crate-jmap-filenode-server still rejects it (src/filenode.rs nulled list, from JMAP-f233 per -16), and tests/filenode_tests.rs filenode_set_update_null_type_property_is_invalid_properties asserts the old behavior. Raised by Mark on jmap@ietf.org 2026-10-18, accepted by Bron the same day.
close_reason: Fixed: null mediaType resets to application/octet-stream per filenode-19 §3.1.2; workspace 6865 passed, clippy clean
